def test_shipping_direct_request():

    shipping_payload = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",

    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment.get("orderId") == order_id

    assert "trackingNumber" in shipment

    shipment_get = resp.json()
    assert shipment_get.get("orderId") == order_id
    assert shipment_get.get("trackingNumber") == shipment.get("trackingNumber")

def test_carts_merge():
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    item = cat_resp.json()[0]
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json={"itemId": item["id"], "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": item["price"]}, timeout=10)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) == 1
    assert cart_items[0]["itemId"] == item["id"]

    bad_session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={bad_session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_direct_authorization():
    order_id = f"ord_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    payment_payload = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "EC1A 1BB",
            "street": "Downing St"
        },
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "123",
            "expires": "12/25",
            "longNum": "1234567890123456"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "John",
            "lastName": "Doe"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth.get("authorised") is True
    assert auth.get("orderId") == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0].get("authorised") is True

    payment_payload["amount"] = 150.0
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth.get("authorised") is False

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 2
    assert auths[1].get("authorised") is False

def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer.get("username") == username
    assert customer.get("firstName") == "Test"
    assert customer.get("lastName") == "User"
    assert "password" not in customer or customer.get("password") != password

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is False

def test_user_address_and_card_management():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={"username": username, "password": "pwd", "email": f"{username}@example.com"}, timeout=10)

    address_payload = {

        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "EC1A 1BB",
        "street": "Downing St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert address_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr = resp.json()
    assert addr.get("city") == "London"
    assert addr.get("id") == address_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    embedded_addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in embedded_addrs)

    card_payload = {
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "ccv": "123",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card = resp.json()
    assert card.get("id") == card_id
    assert card.get("longNum", "").endswith("3456")
    assert "123456789012" not in card.get("longNum", "")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    embedded_cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in embedded_cards)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    assert cart_items[0]["quantity"] == 1

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_orders_end_to_end_placement():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={"username": username, "password": "pwd", "email": f"{username}@example.com", "firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe"}, timeout=10)

    addr_resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json={"city": "London", "country": "UK", "number": "10", "postcode": "EC1A 1BB", "street": "Downing St", "userID": username}, timeout=10)
    address_id = addr_resp.json()["id"]

    card_resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json={"longNum": "1234567890123456", "expires": "12/25", "ccv": "123", "userID": username}, timeout=10)
    card_id = card_resp.json()["id"]

    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    item = cat_resp.json()[0]

    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json={"itemId": item["id"], "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": item["price"]}, timeout=10)

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order.get("customer", {}).get("username") == username
    assert len(order.get("items", [])) == 1
    assert order["items"][0]["itemId"] == item["id"]
    assert order["items"][0]["quantity"] == 2

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_order = resp.json()
    assert fetched_order.get("id") == order_id
    assert fetched_order.get("status") in ["CREATED", "PAID", "SHIPPED", "PAYMENT_FAILED", "SHIPMENT_FAILED"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cust_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in cust_orders)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert len(payments) > 0
    assert payments[0].get("orderId") == order_id
    assert payments[0].get("authorised") is True

    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment.get("orderId") == order_id
